prior_work_baseline: responsive-ui-uplift (verified 2026-05-05): touch targets >= 44px, 1-col dense forms on mobile, segmented grid trip nav, palette refresh.
scroll-issue (verified 2026-05-06): single document scroll owner on desktop, offcanvas mobile menu.

decisions_locked_in: Full-screen <Sheet> for edit forms on mobile (<sm); inline on desktop (>=sm). Single biggest mobile UX shift.
No bottom-nav bar. Workspace app; existing top header + offcanvas sheet is the right pattern.
Swipe-to-reveal Delete + tap-to-edit on rows for mobile. Inline Edit/Delete buttons stay on desktop.
Safe-area insets (top + bottom + left + right) respected on every full-bleed surface via pt-safe / pb-safe / pb-safe-or-4 utilities plus viewport-fit=cover in the meta tag.
Stay with semantically correct input types (number/email/tel/date/etc); layer inputmode + enterkeyhint + autocomplete on top for keyboard hints. Don't swap to type=text for numerics.
Top progress bar via Inertia's progress plugin (color = theme --primary). Per-section skeletons render only where deferred-prop or measurable wait exists.
Toasts: bottom-center on <sm, top-right on >=sm. 44px close button, 4s auto-dismiss (success) / 6s (error), queue if multiple arrive.
Out of scope for this module: PWA, service worker, offline, native apps/Capacitor, pull-to-refresh, haptics, gesture-based panel switching, design-system swap, new microcopy, a11y-only work.

new_components_planned.name: EditSheet
new_components_planned.purpose: Wraps an edit form; renders full-screen Sheet on <sm, inline on >=sm. Provides sticky Cancel/Save header on mobile.

new_components_planned.name: FormSectionPills
new_components_planned.purpose: Sticky horizontal pill scroller for long forms; jumps to sections via getElementById + scrollIntoView.

new_components_planned.name: SwipeRow
new_components_planned.purpose: Touch-only swipe-left-to-reveal-Delete wrapper. Inert on >=sm. Tap on body invokes primary action (edit).

new_components_planned.name: SkeletonRow
new_components_planned.purpose: Pulsing placeholder block for deferred/loading panels. Use only where audit findings call for it.

new_helpers_planned.name: scrollToFirstError
new_helpers_planned.purpose: Pure function: given an errors object, finds the first matching DOM element via [data-error-target] or [name], scrolls it into view, and focuses it.

css_additions_planned: pt-safe, pb-safe, pl-safe, pr-safe, pb-safe-or-4, pt-safe-or-3 utility classes in resources/css/app.css.
scroll-margin-top rules for deep-link anchors (reservation-{id}, packing-item-{id}, etc.).
active:scale-[0.98] + active:bg-primary/90 additions to travel-button-primary and travel-touch classes.
touch-manipulation utility applied to interactive surfaces to suppress double-tap zoom while preserving accessibility zoom.
